result:
{
  "roles": [
    {"name": "Member", "description": "One of the ~62 (up to ~80) freelancers who invoices their own clients, logs expenses and produces a VAT summary."},
    {"name": "Lead member", "description": "The member who runs a shared job. Creates and sends the collective invoice, records each member's share, and is the only one who can edit or send it."},
    {"name": "Participating member", "description": "A member on a shared job who can see the invoice, status and split, and must confirm their share."},
    {"name": "Bookkeeper (Tomasz)", "description": "Works two days a week. Chases receipts, works out who owes what on shared jobs, pays members out from the collective account, and needs the admin views and exports. Two-factor authentication is required."},
    {"name": "Treasurer (currently Ines)", "description": "Collective admin with the same needs as the bookkeeper. Can change the admin fee percentage. Two-factor authentication is required."},
    {"name": "Client", "description": "External party who receives invoices, reminders and possibly quotes by email. Not a user of the system apart from accepting quotes online."},
    {"name": "Accountant", "description": "External. Receives the CSV exports and advises on HMRC rules."}
  ],
  "requirements": [
    {"id": "R-1", "text": "Provide one shared, web-based invoicing and expenses tool used by all members.", "quote": "We want one tool, which we've been calling Tallyhouse, that all members use. Web-based is fine", "priority": "must", "kind": "non-functional"},
    {"id": "R-2", "text": "Let members capture a receipt photo from a phone browser.", "quote": "being able to snap a receipt on a phone browser would be lovely", "priority": "nice", "kind": "functional"},
    {"id": "R-3", "text": "Each member keeps their own client list with name, billing address, optional VAT number, contact email and default payment terms.", "quote": "Each member keeps their own list of clients (name, billing address, VAT number if they have one, contact email, default payment terms).", "priority": "must", "kind": "functional"},
    {"id": "R-4", "text": "Members cannot see other members' clients, except for clients on a shared job they both work on.", "quote": "Members shouldn't see each other's clients unless they're working together on a shared job.", "priority": "must", "kind": "non-functional"},
    {"id": "R-5", "text": "Create invoices from scratch or from a saved template, with line items (description, quantity, unit price, VAT rate) and a discount, and email them to the client as a PDF.", "quote": "Create an invoice from scratch or from a saved template, add line items (description, quantity, unit price, VAT rate), apply a discount, and send it to the client by email as a PDF.", "priority": "must", "kind": "functional"},
    {"id": "R-6", "text": "Invoice numbers run in sequence per member with no gaps.", "quote": "Invoice numbers must run in sequence per member with no gaps", "priority": "must", "kind": "functional"},
    {"id": "R-7", "text": "Invoices carry the member's own business name and logo, except on shared jobs.", "quote": "The invoice should carry the member's own business name and logo, not the collective's, unless it's a shared job.", "priority": "must", "kind": "functional"},
    {"id": "R-8", "text": "Show each invoice's status: draft, sent, viewed, part-paid, paid or overdue.", "quote": "Members need to see each invoice's status: draft, sent, viewed, part-paid, paid, overdue.", "priority": "must", "kind": "functional"},
    {"id": "R-9", "text": "Members manually mark invoices as paid when the client pays.", "quote": "When a client pays, the member marks it paid", "priority": "must", "kind": "functional"},
    {"id": "R-10", "text": "Bank feed integration for automatic payment matching.", "quote": "we'll look at bank feeds later, not now", "priority": "deferred", "kind": "functional"},
    {"id": "R-11", "text": "Send automatic polite reminders for overdue invoices at 7, 14 and 30 days after the due date.", "quote": "Overdue invoices should trigger polite automatic reminders at 7, 14 and 30 days after the due date", "priority": "must", "kind": "functional"},
    {"id": "R-12", "text": "Members can switch reminders off for a particular client.", "quote": "the member should be able to switch reminders off for a particular client", "priority": "must", "kind": "functional"},
    {"id": "R-13", "text": "Support credit notes that reverse all or part of an invoice.", "quote": "Credit notes are needed when a member has to reverse all or part of an invoice.", "priority": "must", "kind": "functional"},
    {"id": "R-14", "text": "A sent invoice cannot be edited. It must be credited and reissued.", "quote": "A sent invoice can't be edited; it has to be credited and reissued.", "priority": "must", "kind": "functional"},
    {"id": "R-15", "text": "A member sends a quote, the client accepts it online, and it converts to an invoice in one click.", "quote": "Nice to have: a member sends a quote, the client accepts it online, and it turns into an invoice with one click.", "priority": "nice", "kind": "functional"},
    {"id": "R-16", "text": "Members log expenses with date, amount, category (travel, software, equipment, materials, studio, other) and a photo or PDF receipt.", "quote": "Members log expenses with a date, amount, category (travel, software, equipment, materials, studio, other), and a photo or PDF of the receipt.", "priority": "must", "kind": "functional"},
    {"id": "R-17", "text": "Expenses can be marked rechargeable to a client and be easily added to that client's next invoice.", "quote": "Expenses can be marked as rechargeable to a client, in which case they should be easy to add to that client's next invoice.", "priority": "must", "kind": "functional"},
    {"id": "R-18", "text": "Log mileage in miles and convert it to an amount at the HMRC rate, which the collective can update each year.", "quote": "Mileage should be logged as miles and turned into an amount at the HMRC rate, which we'd like to be able to update ourselves each year.", "priority": "must", "kind": "functional"},
    {"id": "R-19", "text": "On a shared job the lead creates a single invoice to the client under the collective's name and number series.", "quote": "The lead creates a single invoice to the client under the collective's name and number series.", "priority": "must", "kind": "functional"},
    {"id": "R-20", "text": "The lead records each member's share as a percentage or a fixed amount.", "quote": "the lead records each member's share as a percentage or a fixed amount", "priority": "must", "kind": "functional"},
    {"id": "R-21", "text": "When the client pays a shared-job invoice, show what each member is owed.", "quote": "When the client pays, the tool should show what each member is owed", "priority": "must", "kind": "functional"},
    {"id": "R-22", "text": "Each member's share of shared jobs appears in their own income totals.", "quote": "Each member should see their share in their own income totals.", "priority": "must", "kind": "functional"},
    {"id": "R-23", "text": "Deduct a 4% collective admin fee from every shared job before the split.", "quote": "The collective keeps a 4% admin fee from every shared job before the split", "priority": "must", "kind": "functional"},
    {"id": "R-24", "text": "The treasurer can change the admin fee percentage.", "quote": "we'd like the treasurer to be able to change it", "priority": "must", "kind": "functional"},
    {"id": "R-25", "text": "Other members on a shared job can see the invoice and its status, but only the lead can edit or send it.", "quote": "The other members on a shared job should be able to see the invoice and its status, but only the lead can edit or send it.", "priority": "must", "kind": "functional"},
    {"id": "R-26", "text": "Show the split to everyone on the job before the invoice goes out, and require every member on the job to confirm their share first.", "quote": "the split should be visible to everyone on the job before the invoice goes out, and every member on the job should confirm their share first", "priority": "must", "kind": "functional"},
    {"id": "R-27", "text": "If a member has not confirmed within three working days, the lead can proceed anyway and the tool records that.", "quote": "If someone doesn't confirm within three working days, the lead can go ahead anyway and the tool should record that.", "priority": "must", "kind": "functional"},
    {"id": "R-28", "text": "Give admins a view of all shared-job invoices, payments received and payouts due.", "quote": "A view of all shared-job invoices, payments received and payouts due.", "priority": "must", "kind": "functional"},
    {"id": "R-29", "text": "Bill each member a £35 monthly membership fee as an invoice from the collective to the member.", "quote": "each member pays £35 a month to the collective, which should appear as an invoice from the collective to the member", "priority": "must", "kind": "functional"},
    {"id": "R-30", "text": "Export a CSV of sales, expenses and VAT per member per quarter, plus the shared-job ledger, for the accountant.", "quote": "a CSV of sales, expenses and VAT per member per quarter, plus the shared-job ledger", "priority": "must", "kind": "functional"},
    {"id": "R-31", "text": "Admins can add new members and deactivate leavers while keeping their records.", "quote": "The ability to add new members and deactivate members who leave (but keep their records).", "priority": "must", "kind": "functional"},
    {"id": "R-32", "text": "Support both VAT-registered and non-registered members. Invoices of non-registered members never show VAT.", "quote": "Non-registered members' invoices must not show VAT at all.", "priority": "must", "kind": "functional"},
    {"id": "R-33", "text": "Each member can produce a simple VAT summary for their quarter.", "quote": "Each member should be able to produce a simple VAT summary for their quarter", "priority": "must", "kind": "functional"},
    {"id": "R-34", "text": "Direct VAT filing to HMRC.", "quote": "we are not asking for direct filing to HMRC in this version", "priority": "deferred", "kind": "functional"},
    {"id": "R-35", "text": "Allow invoicing in euros and Mexican pesos as well as pounds (requested by a translator member).", "quote": "necesito facturar en euros y en pesos mexicanos, no solo en libras", "priority": "must", "kind": "functional"},
    {"id": "R-36", "text": "Let the PDF invoice be produced in Spanish, with translated fixed texts, when the client asks.", "quote": "También sería muy útil que la factura en PDF pudiera salir en español cuando el cliente lo pide", "priority": "nice", "kind": "functional"},
    {"id": "R-37", "text": "Pages load in under 2 seconds on a normal broadband connection.", "quote": "Pages should load in under 2 seconds on a normal broadband connection", "priority": "must", "kind": "non-functional"},
    {"id": "R-38", "text": "PDF invoice generation takes no more than 5 seconds.", "quote": "generating a PDF invoice shouldn't take more than 5 seconds", "priority": "must", "kind": "non-functional"},
    {"id": "R-39", "text": "Support about 80 members within two years and roughly 6,000 invoices a year in total.", "quote": "We expect up to about 80 members within two years and maybe 6,000 invoices a year in total.", "priority": "must", "kind": "non-functional"},
    {"id": "R-40", "text": "Keep invoices, credit notes, expenses and receipts for at least 6 years after the end of the relevant financial year, even if the member leaves. They may then be deleted automatically.", "quote": "must be kept for at least 6 years after the end of the financial year they relate to, even if the member leaves the collective. After that they can be deleted automatically.", "priority": "must", "kind": "non-functional"},
    {"id": "R-41", "text": "Take daily backups and be able to restore from them.", "quote": "Daily backups, and we need to be able to restore if something goes wrong.", "priority": "must", "kind": "non-functional"},
    {"id": "R-42", "text": "Members log in with email and password.", "quote": "Members log in with email and password", "priority": "must", "kind": "non-functional"},
    {"id": "R-43", "text": "Offer two-factor authentication, and require it for the bookkeeper and the treasurer.", "quote": "we'd like two-factor authentication to be available, and required for Tomasz and the treasurer", "priority": "must", "kind": "non-functional"},
    {"id": "R-44", "text": "Host data in the UK or EU.", "quote": "Data should be hosted in the UK or EU.", "priority": "must", "kind": "non-functional"},
    {"id": "R-45", "text": "Target go-live on 6 April next year, the start of the tax year.", "quote": "We'd love to start using it from 6 April next year so that the new tax year starts clean.", "priority": "nice", "kind": "non-functional"}
  ],
  "gaps": [
    {"question": "Is the collective VAT-registered? How is VAT handled on a shared-job invoice issued in the collective's name when members are a mix of VAT-registered and non-registered, and how does each member's VAT summary treat their share?", "severity": "blocking"},
    {"question": "Is the 4% admin fee calculated on the gross, net-of-VAT or net-of-expenses amount? How are rounding and part-payments handled, and may percentage and fixed-amount shares be mixed on one job? Must shares always total 100% of the post-fee amount?", "severity": "blocking"},
    {"question": "How should the system behave when a client part-pays a shared-job invoice, or when a credit note is issued against one? Are payouts proportional, and does the split get recalculated?", "severity": "blocking"},
    {"question": "What does a member see if they disagree with their share? Is there a reject or dispute step? Must everyone re-confirm if the lead changes the split after confirmations?", "severity": "important"},
    {"question": "Does Tallyhouse record payouts made by Tomasz (paid, date, reference), or only show amounts owed? Does the collective want payout reconciliation?", "severity": "important"},
    {"question": "For multi-currency invoicing (EUR, MXN): how are exchange rates set, and in what currency do the VAT summary, income totals, shared-job ledger and CSV exports report? Does VAT apply to overseas clients? Is any Mexican e-invoicing format required, or only a PDF in the client's language?", "severity": "important"},
    {"question": "Can shared jobs be in currencies other than GBP, and which languages are needed beyond Spanish?", "severity": "minor"},
    {"question": "What exactly can the bookkeeper and treasurer see across members (invoices, clients, expenses, receipts)? How does this fit with the rule that members can't see each other's clients?", "severity": "important"},
    {"question": "What is the format and numbering of the collective's number series, of credit notes, and of membership-fee invoices? How do these keep the no-gaps rule, including for discarded drafts?", "severity": "important"},
    {"question": "How should existing invoice numbers be carried over when members migrate from Word, spreadsheets and other tools? Is historical data to be imported, and does numbering restart for the new tax year?", "severity": "important"},
    {"question": "Are membership fees charged with VAT, how are they paid (deducted from shared-job payouts, or paid separately), and what happens when a member doesn't pay?", "severity": "important"},
    {"question": "How is the 'viewed' status to be determined (email open tracking, a link to an online invoice page)? Is the client expected to have a payment link or online payment, and which bank or payment details should appear on invoices?", "severity": "important"},
    {"question": "Do reminders come from the member's address or a system address, can the wording be edited, and do reminders apply to shared-job invoices (and who can switch them off)?", "severity": "minor"},
    {"question": "Which mileage rates apply (e.g. different rates by vehicle or by annual mileage threshold)? How is VAT treated on rechargeable expenses added to an invoice?", "severity": "minor"},
    {"question": "What happens to a leaving member's access to their own records, and how does the 6-year retention rule interact with GDPR erasure requests for client data?", "severity": "important"},
    {"question": "Is the 6 April date fixed? The brief says individual invoicing and expenses come first and shared jobs second if the date is too ambitious. Should that phasing be assumed as the plan, and is quotes (nice to have) a third phase?", "severity": "important"},
    {"question": "What is the budget, who will build and host the system, and who administers it after launch?", "severity": "important"},
    {"question": "Can a member take part in several shared jobs at once, can the lead be changed mid-job, and can a shared job involve non-members?", "severity": "minor"},
    {"question": "Should the accountant have a login, or only receive exports? Are there other required export formats beyond CSV?", "severity": "minor"}
  ],
  "contradictions": [
    {"quote_a": "every member on the job should confirm their share first", "quote_b": "If someone doesn't confirm within three working days, the lead can go ahead anyway and the tool should record that.", "why": "Confirmation is described as mandatory before sending, but the lead may then proceed without it. It is unclear whether confirmation is a hard gate or advisory."},
    {"quote_a": "Invoice numbers must run in sequence per member with no gaps", "quote_b": "The lead creates a single invoice to the client under the collective's name and number series.", "why": "Numbering is required per member, but shared-job invoices use the collective's own series. It is unclear whether the lead's own sequence is affected and how the gap-free rule applies to the collective series."}
  ],
  "out_of_scope": [
    "Bank feed integration (later)",
    "Direct VAT filing to HMRC in this version",
    "A native phone app (not requested)",
    "A fully Spanish-language application (only invoices need Spanish)"
  ],

  ],
  "status": "draft"
}
